package lint

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// This overlay uses the area's artifact builder without editing its harness.
func TestScoutArtifacts(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	directory := os.Getenv("ADAMIC_SCOUT_OUTPUT")
	if directory == "" {
		t.Fatal("ADAMIC_SCOUT_OUTPUT is required")
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(directory, 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	copyPort(t, directory, "", "")
	prepareRegistry(t, directory)
	if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(directory, "profiled")); err != nil {
		buildProfile(t, directory)
	}
	oracle := goOracle(t)
	data, err := os.ReadFile(oracle)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(directory, "oracle"), data, 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	rows := upstream(t)
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(directory, "upstream.txt"), []byte(strings.Join(rows, "\n")+"\n"), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// Captured fixture files are run-owned; preserve them before cleanup.
	var kept []string
	for i, row := range rows {
		fields := strings.Split(row, "\t")
		source, err := os.ReadFile(fields[0])
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		target := filepath.Join(directory, "fixtures", filepath.Base(fields[0]))
		// Prefixes avoid collisions across capture directories.
		target = filepath.Join(directory, "fixtures", fmtName(i)+"-"+filepath.Base(fields[0]))
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(target), 0755); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(target, source, 0644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		fields[0] = target
		kept = append(kept, strings.Join(fields, "\t"))
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(directory, "upstream.txt"), []byte(strings.Join(kept, "\n")+"\n"), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
func fmtName(value int) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%06d", value) }

func TestScoutEncoding(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	directory := os.Getenv("ADAMIC_SCOUT_OUTPUT")
	encoder := os.Getenv("ADAMIC_SCOUT_ENCODER")
	if directory == "" || encoder == "" {
		t.Fatal("ADAMIC_SCOUT_OUTPUT and ADAMIC_SCOUT_ENCODER required")
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(directory, 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	copyPort(t, directory, "", "")
	path := filepath.Join(directory, "main.ts")
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
	changed := 0
	for i, line := range lines {
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "import { written } from ") {
			lines[i] = "import { written } from '" + encoder + "';"
			changed++
		}
	}
	if changed != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("encoder import anchor count %d", changed)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(strings.Join(lines, "\n")), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	buildProfile(t, directory)
}
